kurzbeschreibung: The **Zillertal** is **Tirol**’s largest side valley—a paradise for skiers, hikers, and families with the famous **Zillertaler Arena**.
beschreibung: The **Zillertal** stretches over 40 kilometers from Strass im Zillertal all the way up to the Tuxer Fernerhaus. With its seven side valleys, it offers one of the most diverse holiday landscapes in Tirol. In winter, the ski resorts Zillertal Arena, Ski & Gletscherwelt Zillertal 3000, and Spieljoch-Fügen attract visitors with over 500 kilometers of ski runs. In summer, one of the largest contiguous hiking areas in the Alps awaits, along with the Berliner Höhenweg trail and wildwater kayaking on the Ziller.
tipps: Die Zillertaler Museumsbahn fährt im Sommer mit Dampflokomotive durchs Tal.
Der Wildwasserkanal in Fügen ist Europas größte künstliche Wildwasseranlage.
Die Schlegeis-Alm-Straße ist mautpflichtig, aber die Aussicht lohnt sich.
empfehlungen: Our top recommendation: Take a hike around the **Schlegeisspeicher** – the turquoise reservoir backdrop is one of Tirol’s most photographed sights. Afterwards, stop by the Alpenrose at the Friesenberghütte for a break.
umgebung: The **Zillertal** borders the **Inntal** to the north and the **Alpenhauptkamm** (Italy) to the south. Neighboring regions include the **Tuxertal** (a side valley of the **Zillertal**), **Gerlos**, and **Krimml** (Salzburg). The **Zillertaler Alpen** are part of the central **Ostalpen**.
